title: Result 3: Hospital-community model
text:
Counterfactual hospital vs no hospital

## total infections, run to fade-out, for one set of conditions
total_infections <- function(beta_C, kappa, p_a, p_i, s_C0, s_H0, seed,
                             los, adm, threshold = 1, ...) {
  stopifnot(seed > threshold)   # otherwise the run stops at once
  
  N_H   <- adm * los
  N_C   <- N - N_H
  xi    <- s_H0 * (1 - s_C0) / (s_C0 * (1 - s_H0))
  alpha <- adm / N_C / (1 + s_C0 * (xi - 1))
  
  y0 <- c(S_C = s_C0 * N_C - seed, E_C = seed, I_C_pre = 0, I_C_post = 0,
          R_C = (1 - s_C0) * N_C,
          S_H = s_H0 * N_H, E_H = 0, I_H_pre = 0, I_H_post = 0, Q = 0,
          R_H = (1 - s_H0) * N_H,
          cum_onset_C = 0, cum_onset_H = 0, cum_noso = 0,
          cum_adm_rash = 0, cum_inf_C = 0)[state_names]
  
  p <- c(beta_C = beta_C, beta_H = kappa * beta_C,
         xi_alpha = xi * alpha, alpha = alpha, p_a = p_a, p_i = p_i,
         delta = 1 / los, delta_M = delta_M,
         sigma = sigma, eta = eta, gamma = gamma)
  
  sol <- ode(y0, 0:max_days, measles_ode, p, method = "lsoda",
             rootfunc = make_stop_condition(threshold),
             atol = 1e-3, rtol = 1e-6)
  last <- function(x) unname(sol[nrow(sol), x])   # value at the stop time
  
  tibble(total = last("cum_inf_C") + last("cum_noso"),   # infections after the start
         noso  = last("cum_noso"),
         faded = last("time") < max_days)
}

## total infections for every row of a scenario table (keeps the input columns)
run_all <- function(scen) bind_cols(scen, pmap(scen, total_infections) |> list_rbind())

## the same population without the hospital: no admissions and no transmission
## inside. Children with rash stay in the community and transmit like other
## children with rash, as the model assumes for children who are not admitted.
## The children who would have been inpatients live in the community, so
## community immunity becomes the population average (this uses the original
## adm, so keep it first).
no_hospital <- function(scen) {
  scen |>
    mutate(s_C0  = (s_C0 * (N - adm * los) + s_H0 * adm * los) / N,
           kappa = 0,
           p_a   = 0,
           adm   = 0)   # no admissions, so N_H = adm * los = 0: no hospital
}

## scenario values shared by both panels
los_grid   <- seq(2, 14, by = 1)          # x-axis: mean length of stay (days)
kappa_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)         # y-axis

## =============================================================================

gsea6 <- pal_gsea("default", n = 6)(6)

## one heatmap design for both panels: length of stay by kappa, one panel per

net_heatmap <- function(data, facets, labeller, fitted_pt) {
  ggplot(data, aes(los, kappa)) +
    geom_contour_filled(aes(z = net_pct), breaks = brk_net, show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_contour(aes(z = net_pct), breaks = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +

## A: the fitted hospital sits in the panel with the fitted s_H0 and p_i
fig_A <- net_heatmap(

## ---- 2. kappa above which the hospital amplifies (the black line) ---------------
## linear interpolation between the last kappa below 0% and the first at or above;
## NA means the hospital does not amplify for any kappa up to 1
kappa_amp <- function(kappa, net) {
  i <- which(net >= 0)[1]
  if (is.na(i)) return(NA_real_)
  if (i == 1) return(kappa[1])
  kappa[i - 1] + (0 - net[i - 1]) * (kappa[i] - kappa[i - 1]) / (net[i] - net[i - 1])
}

title: Result 3: Hospital-community model
text:
R0H and R0C validation
The simulation set everyone in the population susceptible, and introduce 1 infectious in the pre-rash state in the community (to check R0C), or hospital (to check R0H).

## ---- closed forms from the next-generation matrix ----------------------------
r0h_formula <- function(beta_H,
                        eta,
                        gamma,
                        delta,
                        xi_alpha,
                        p_a,
                        p_i) {
  k <- eta + xi_alpha + delta
  beta_H * ((eta + xi_alpha) / (eta * k) +
              (1 - p_i) / gamma * (eta + xi_alpha + p_a * delta) / k)
}

r0c_formula <- function(beta_C, eta, gamma, delta, xi_alpha, p_a) {
  k <- eta + xi_alpha + delta
  beta_C * (eta + delta) / k * (1 / eta + (1 - p_a) / gamma)
}

## ---- the same quantities from the model ODE -----------------------------------
## seed_in: compartment of the index child ("I_H_pre" or "I_C_pre")
## count:   which infections to count ("cum_noso" or "cum_inf_C")
## Everyone is susceptible, so S_C = N_C and S_H = N_H at the start.
simulate_new_infections <- function(beta_C,
                                    beta_H,
                                    eta,
                                    gamma,
                                    delta,
                                    xi_alpha,
                                    p_a,
                                    p_i,
                                    N_C,
                                    N_H,
                                    seed_in,
                                    count) {
  y0 <- c(
    S_C = N_C,
    E_C = 0,
    I_C_pre = 0,
    I_C_post = 0,
    R_C = 0,
    S_H = N_H,
    E_H = 0,
    I_H_pre = 0,
    I_H_post = 0,
    Q = 0,
    R_H = 0,
    cum_onset_C = 0,
    cum_onset_H = 0,
    cum_noso = 0,
    cum_adm_rash = 0,
    cum_inf_C = 0
  )[state_names]
  y0[seed_in] <- 1   # one infectious child
  
  p <- c(
    beta_C = beta_C,
    beta_H = beta_H,
    xi_alpha = xi_alpha,
    alpha = 0,
    p_a = p_a,
    p_i = p_i,
    sigma = 0,
    eta = eta,
    gamma = gamma,
    delta = delta,
    delta_M = 1 / 7
  )
  
  ## long enough for the index child to finish its infectious period
  t_end <- 50 / min(eta, gamma)
  
  out <- ode(y0,
             c(0, t_end),
             measles_ode,
             p,
             rtol = 1e-10,
             atol = 1e-10)
  out[2, count]
}

## ---- parameter sets -------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. the baseline values
baseline <- tibble(
  beta_C = 15 / 8,
  beta_H = 15 / 8,
  eta = 1 / 4,
  gamma = 1 / 4,
  delta = 1 / 5.2,
  xi_alpha = 0.001,
  p_a = 0.3,
  p_i = 0.9
)

## 2. the baseline with p_a and p_i at their limits (0 or 1)
edges <- baseline |>
  select(-p_a, -p_i) |>
  expand_grid(p_a = c(0, 1), p_i = c(0, 1))

## 3. random values over wide ranges
set.seed(2026)
n_random <- 200
random <- tibble(
  beta_C   = runif(n_random, 0.5, 5),
  beta_H   = runif(n_random, 0.1, 10),
  eta      = 1 / runif(n_random, 1, 7),
  # pre-rash infectious period, 1 to 7 days
  gamma    = 1 / runif(n_random, 1, 7),
  # post-rash infectious period, 1 to 7 days
  delta    = 1 / runif(n_random, 1, 30),
  # length of stay, 1 to 30 days
  xi_alpha = runif(n_random, 0.001, 0.01),
  p_a      = runif(n_random),
  p_i      = runif(n_random)
)

## population sizes
## N_C is very large, so that the infections caused by one child do not reduce
## the susceptible proportion. R_0H and R_0C do not depend on N_C or N_H.
## N_H = adm * los, with adm = xi_alpha * N_C admissions per day and
## los = 1 / delta. This makes admissions equal discharges, so the population
## sizes stay constant. xi_alpha must be above 0, otherwise N_H = 0.
pars <- bind_rows(
  baseline = baseline,
  edges = edges,
  random = random,
  .id = "set"
) |>
  mutate(N_C = 1e6, N_H = xi_alpha * N_C / delta)

## ---- compare -------------------------------------------------------------------
## pick() passes each row's parameters to simulate_new_infections() by name
check <- pars |>
  mutate(
    R0H_formula   = r0h_formula(beta_H, eta, gamma, delta, xi_alpha, p_a, p_i),
    R0H_simulated = pmap_dbl(
      pick(beta_C:N_H),
      simulate_new_infections,
      seed_in = "I_H_pre",
      count = "cum_noso"
    ),
    R0C_formula   = r0c_formula(beta_C, eta, gamma, delta, xi_alpha, p_a),
    R0C_simulated = pmap_dbl(
      pick(beta_C:N_H),
      simulate_new_infections,
      seed_in = "I_C_pre",
      count = "cum_inf_C"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("R0"),
    names_to = c("quantity", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |>
  mutate(rel_diff = simulated / formula - 1)

## the baseline and the four limit cases
check |>
  filter(set != "random") |>
  select(quantity, set, p_a, p_i, formula, simulated, rel_diff) |>
  arrange(quantity)

10 R0H      edges      1     1      4.25      4.24 -0.000380  

## all parameter sets
check |>
  group_by(quantity) |>

title: Result 3: Hospital-community model
text:
R0H
The simulation set everyone in the population susceptible, and introduce 1 infectious in the pre-rash state in the community (to check R0C), or hospital (to check R0H).

## ---- closed forms from the next-generation matrix ----------------------------
r0h_formula <- function(beta_H,
                        eta,
                        gamma,
                        delta,
                        xi_alpha,
                        p_a,
                        p_i) {
  k <- eta + xi_alpha + delta
  beta_H * ((eta + xi_alpha) / (eta * k) +
              (1 - p_i) / gamma * (eta + xi_alpha + p_a * delta) / k)
}

r0c_formula <- function(beta_C, eta, gamma, delta, xi_alpha, p_a) {
  k <- eta + xi_alpha + delta
  beta_C * (eta + delta) / k * (1 / eta + (1 - p_a) / gamma)
}

## ---- the same quantities from the model ODE -----------------------------------
## seed_in: compartment of the index child ("I_H_pre" or "I_C_pre")
## count:   which infections to count ("cum_noso" or "cum_inf_C")
## Everyone is susceptible, so S_C = N_C and S_H = N_H at the start.
simulate_new_infections <- function(beta_C,
                                    beta_H,
                                    eta,
                                    gamma,
                                    delta,
                                    xi_alpha,
                                    p_a,
                                    p_i,
                                    N_C,
                                    N_H,
                                    seed_in,
                                    count) {
  y0 <- c(
    S_C = N_C,
    E_C = 0,
    I_C_pre = 0,
    I_C_post = 0,
    R_C = 0,
    S_H = N_H,
    E_H = 0,
    I_H_pre = 0,
    I_H_post = 0,
    Q = 0,
    R_H = 0,
    cum_onset_C = 0,
    cum_onset_H = 0,
    cum_noso = 0,
    cum_adm_rash = 0,
    cum_inf_C = 0
  )[state_names]
  y0[seed_in] <- 1   # one infectious child
  
  p <- c(
    beta_C = beta_C,
    beta_H = beta_H,
    xi_alpha = xi_alpha,
    alpha = 0,
    p_a = p_a,
    p_i = p_i,
    sigma = 0,
    eta = eta,
    gamma = gamma,
    delta = delta,
    delta_M = 1 / 7
  )
  
  ## long enough for the index child to finish its infectious period
  t_end <- 50 / min(eta, gamma)
  
  out <- ode(y0,
             c(0, t_end),
             measles_ode,
             p,
             rtol = 1e-10,
             atol = 1e-10)
  out[2, count]
}

## ---- parameter sets -------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. the baseline values
baseline <- tibble(
  beta_C = 15 / 8,
  beta_H = 15 / 8,
  eta = 1 / 4,
  gamma = 1 / 4,
  delta = 1 / 5.2,
  xi_alpha = 0.001,
  p_a = 0.3,
  p_i = 0.9
)

## 2. the baseline with p_a and p_i at their limits (0 or 1)
edges <- baseline |>
  select(-p_a, -p_i) |>
  expand_grid(p_a = c(0, 1), p_i = c(0, 1))

## 3. random values over wide ranges
set.seed(2026)
n_random <- 200
random <- tibble(
  beta_C   = runif(n_random, 0.5, 5),
  beta_H   = runif(n_random, 0.1, 10),
  eta      = 1 / runif(n_random, 1, 7),
  # pre-rash infectious period, 1 to 7 days
  gamma    = 1 / runif(n_random, 1, 7),
  # post-rash infectious period, 1 to 7 days
  delta    = 1 / runif(n_random, 1, 30),
  # length of stay, 1 to 30 days
  xi_alpha = runif(n_random, 0.001, 0.01),
  p_a      = runif(n_random),
  p_i      = runif(n_random)
)

## population sizes
## N_C is very large, so that the infections caused by one child do not reduce
## the susceptible proportion. R_0H and R_0C do not depend on N_C or N_H.
## N_H = adm * los, with adm = xi_alpha * N_C admissions per day and
## los = 1 / delta. This makes admissions equal discharges, so the population
## sizes stay constant. xi_alpha must be above 0, otherwise N_H = 0.
pars <- bind_rows(
  baseline = baseline,
  edges = edges,
  random = random,
  .id = "set"
) |>
  mutate(N_C = 1e6, N_H = xi_alpha * N_C / delta)

## ---- compare -------------------------------------------------------------------
## pick() passes each row's parameters to simulate_new_infections() by name
check <- pars |>
  mutate(
    R0H_formula   = r0h_formula(beta_H, eta, gamma, delta, xi_alpha, p_a, p_i),
    R0H_simulated = pmap_dbl(
      pick(beta_C:N_H),
      simulate_new_infections,
      seed_in = "I_H_pre",
      count = "cum_noso"
    ),
    R0C_formula   = r0c_formula(beta_C, eta, gamma, delta, xi_alpha, p_a),
    R0C_simulated = pmap_dbl(
      pick(beta_C:N_H),
      simulate_new_infections,
      seed_in = "I_C_pre",
      count = "cum_inf_C"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("R0"),
    names_to = c("quantity", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |>
  mutate(rel_diff = simulated / formula - 1)

## the baseline and the four limit cases
check |>
  filter(set != "random") |>
  select(quantity, set, p_a, p_i, formula, simulated, rel_diff) |>
  arrange(quantity)
